SHOT: A worn photograph, square to camera: the necklace at the base of the throat lying flat on the collarbones, centred. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: chin, neck, collarbones, shoulders and upper chest.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; in it the necklace is worn by a woman in a white top: ignore her, her top, her hair, her long nails and the two white arrow icons, and take only the necklace from it. IMAGE 2 is our approved packshot of this exact piece: the authority on its size, proportions, metal colour and finish; the piece in this picture must match it exactly. IMAGE 3 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn around the neck; any other jewellery in IMAGE 3 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A CLASSIC TENNIS NECKLACE: ONE continuous unbroken line of identical small ROUND brilliant-cut clear stones, each in its own four-claw cup, linked edge to edge all the way round with no chain, no gaps, no pendant, no centre station and no buckle; a small box clasp at the back. Every stone is the same size and round, never graduated, never baguette or square; one single row only, never two rows; every stone is icy clear white with rainbow sparkle, never tinted; nothing hangs from it.

SCALE TEST: The line is only 3mm wide: THINNER than the camisole's narrow spaghetti strap, a fine thread of light lying on the skin at the base of the neck, just above the collarbones; each stone is the size of a mustard seed, and about forty stones show across the front of the neck. A delicate everyday necklace, never a bold statement chain. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: bright rhodium silver tone, never grey or dull, never gold. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette, no old-photo print look, no cracks, crackle, creases or scratches on the picture: a clean modern digital photograph that fills the whole frame edge to edge.
